title: Spicy Algerian Tagine with Tofu
description: A North African-inspired stew made with tender tofu, flavorful spices, and a rich, slightly sweet sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard seeds, spice blend, chickpeas, apricots, and broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the flavors have melded together and the tofu is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and honey (if using).
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
